properties.name: variant
properties.description: Picker mode shown when the dialog first opens. Defaults to `input` (keyboard-first); users can toggle to `dial` from the footer icon.

properties.name: format
properties.description: 12-hour (with AM/PM) or 24-hour clock.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Selected time as a 24-hour `HH:MM` string (e.g. `"14:30"`).

properties.name: name
properties.description: Form field name — the picker is form-associated and submits its `value` under this name in `FormData`, like a native `<input type="time">`.

properties.name: min
properties.description: Earliest selectable time as a 24-hour `HH:MM` string. A committed value before it fails constraint validation with `rangeUnderflow`.

properties.name: max
properties.description: Latest selectable time as a 24-hour `HH:MM` string. A committed value after it fails constraint validation with `rangeOverflow`.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Requires a committed value for the host form to validate (`valueMissing` otherwise).

properties.name: label
properties.description: Trigger field label (acts as the floating label of the text-field-shaped trigger).

properties.name: supportingText
properties.description: Helper text shown below the trigger. Hidden while an error is displayed.

properties.name: error
properties.description: Error state — paints the trigger with the error colour and shows `error-text`.

properties.name: errorText
properties.description: Error message shown below the trigger when `error` is true.

properties.name: reserveSupportingSpace
properties.description:
Always occupy the supporting-text line, even when there is no message, so a
validation error does not push the content below it down. Forwarded to the
embedded md-text-field. See that component for why it is opt-in.

properties.name: headline
properties.description:
Headline copy shown above the dial / inputs. Overrides the
mode-specific defaults (`headline-input-label` / `headline-dial-label`)
when set.

properties.name: headlineInputLabel
properties.description: Localized default headline for the input variant (used when `headline` is empty).

properties.name: headlineDialLabel
properties.description: Localized default headline for the dial variant (used when `headline` is empty).

properties.name: valueMissingLabel
properties.description: Localized constraint-validation message when `required` and no time is committed.

properties.name: rangeUnderflowLabel
properties.default: 'Please select a time at or after {min}.'
properties.defaultValue: Please select a time at or after {min}.
properties.description: Localized validation message when the committed time is before `min`. `{min}` is substituted.

properties.name: rangeOverflowLabel
properties.default: 'Please select a time at or before {max}.'
properties.defaultValue: Please select a time at or before {max}.
properties.description: Localized validation message when the committed time is after `max`. `{max}` is substituted.

properties.name: rangeOutsideLabel
properties.default: 'Please select a time at or after {min} or at or before {max}.'
properties.defaultValue: Please select a time at or after {min} or at or before {max}.
properties.description: Localized validation message for a reversed (overnight) `min`/`max` window when the time falls in the excluded middle. `{min}` and `{max}` are substituted.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Disables the trigger and prevents the dialog from opening.

properties.name: open
properties.description: Whether the picker dialog is open. Two-way bindable / reflected.

properties.name: minuteStep
properties.description: Minute snap increment on the dial (1, 5, 10, 15, 30…). Inputs always accept 1-minute granularity.

properties.name: cancelLabel
properties.description: Localized label for the Cancel action.

properties.name: okLabel
properties.description: Localized label for the confirm action.

properties.name: hideTrigger
properties.description: When true the built-in field trigger is not rendered; open the dialog programmatically via `.show()`.

properties.name: amLabel
properties.description: Localized AM label (12-hour mode).

properties.name: pmLabel
properties.description: Localized PM label (12-hour mode).

properties.name: hourLabel
properties.description:
Localized accessible label for the Hour input field. Matches the
[MD3 Time picker accessibility spec](https://m3.material.io/components/time-pickers/accessibility)
which mandates an "Hour" label on the hour text input.

properties.name: minuteLabel
properties.description:
Localized accessible label for the Minute input field. Matches the
[MD3 Time picker accessibility spec](https://m3.material.io/components/time-pickers/accessibility)
which mandates a "Minute" label on the minute text input.

properties.name: toggleDialLabel
properties.description:
Localized accessible label for the mode-toggle icon button when the
picker is currently in the *input* variant (clock icon shown — click
to switch to the dial). Matches the MD3 accessibility spec entry
"Clock button → Toggle dial picker".

properties.name: toggleInputLabel
properties.description:
Localized accessible label for the mode-toggle icon button when the
picker is currently in the *dial* variant (keyboard icon shown —
click to switch back to the input). Symmetric extension of the MD3
"Toggle dial picker" naming pattern, since the spec only documents
the input-mode label explicitly.

properties.name: periodLabel
properties.description:
Localized accessible label for the AM/PM radio group container.
Wraps the two radio children; individual radio names come from
`am-label` / `pm-label`.

properties.name: periodLayout
properties.description:
Layout for the AM/PM period selector. Has no effect when
`format="24h"` (the toggle is not rendered).

- `vertical` — 52×72px stack next to the minute tile (default).
- `horizontal` — 216×38px segmented button below HH:MM.

properties.name: orientation
properties.description:
Dialog orientation for the dial variant.

- `vertical` (default) — single-column portrait layout (~328px wide).
- `horizontal` — two-column landscape layout (~572px wide in both
  12h and 24h modes since the HH/MM input tiles are 96px in either
  format). Forces the AM/PM pill into the 216×38px horizontal
  variant since the 52×72px vertical pill cannot share the left
  column cleanly. Has no effect when `variant="input"`.

properties.name: responsive
properties.description:
Adaptive layout policy. Per the MD3 spec the picker should swap
orientation or variant based on the viewport so the dial never
has to scroll. When `responsive` is enabled the dialog
automatically:

  • Falls back to `variant="input"` when the viewport height is
    too short to fit the 256px dial (default threshold: 460px),
    matching the spec line "Time pickers can fallback to the
    input time picker when there isn't enough vertical real
    estate to present the landscape orientation without
    scrolling".
  • Promotes the dial variant to `orientation="horizontal"`
    when the viewport is wide enough for the 572/608px landscape
    dialog (default threshold: width ≥ 720px AND width > height),
    matching "the time picker can change to landscape orientation
    on larger breakpoints or when viewport height is limited".

The `variant` / `orientation` props remain the *preference*
the picker tries to honor — adaptive overrides only kick in
when the viewport literally cannot fit them. Default `false`
for backward compatibility; flip to `true` on new integrations
to get the canonical MD3 adaptive layout.

properties.name: density
properties.description:
Local density rung. Drives the same `--md-sys-density-scale` signal that a
global `data-density` ancestor sets, so a local value simply overrides the
inherited one. 0 = default, -4 = ultra-compact.

cssProperties.name: --md-time-picker-input-height
cssProperties.description: HH/MM tile block-size (default 72px = 1.6 x the font; derived from the font unless set)

cssProperties.name: --md-time-picker-period-vertical-height

cssProperties.name: --md-time-picker-period-vertical-height-input

name: Time Picker
description: Choose a time, by dial or by typing. 12h/24h formats, min/max bounds with templated validation messages, overnight ranges, and full constraint validation.

notes: Dedicated native renderers (SwiftUI AWCNativeTimePicker, Compose NativeTimePicker): the read-only trigger field and the modal dialog (dial and input variants, 12h / 24h, the period toggle, the landscape and responsive layouts) in the AWCModalScope layer; Compose presents in its own modal layer.

The 81 source hooks through AWCTimePickerAppearance, a hook map (.awcTimePickerAppearance(_:) / AWCTimePickerAppearanceScope): CSS text as the stylesheet reads it, motion-easing as cubic-bezier() and hand-length as a percentage of the dial radius.

Methods through AWCTimePickerController: show(), hide() (Cancel: mdCancel then mdClose), checkValidity(), reportValidity() (shows the message as the trigger's error text and focuses the trigger) and getValidity().

Events with the source details (mdInput / mdChange time records, mdOpen, mdClose, mdCancel, mdModeChange, mdValidityChange), the dialog's focus trap and the focus return to the trigger. macOS SwiftUI, the iOS simulator and the Android emulator are verified against the Chrome 153 oracles (paint and interaction).
